svg.title: Activated managed-resource atlas
svg.desc: Every resource kind in the checked-in activation map is named here. Family labels disambiguate Stack, Schedule, Rule and Installation; observe-only API groups are separated.
svg.text: 92 activated resource kinds, grouped by API family
Not counted above: ProviderConfig, Secret, ExternalSecret, PushSecret, SecretStore, XRD, Composition, Function, Provider and Argo objects.
MANAGE: management API family, not permission to create every resource. OBSERVE: data-source / lookup GVKs.
